title: DC-area forecast: A sticky week with stubborn storm chances
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Falling through the 80s this evening as a few showers and thunderstorms remain possible in far Southern Maryland. Humidity is briefly down tonight behind a front.

What’s next? Less humid Tuesday with what may be the week's only break from rain chances. Humidity returns Wednesday, with daily chances for afternoon and evening showers and storms through the rest of the workweek.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Party cloudy this evening and it should be dry for most of the region, other than the chance of an early shower or storm in far Southern Maryland. Humidity eases a bit overnight, with lows from the mid-60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): This should be the week's nicest day, with partly sunny skies, moderate humidity (dew points in the mid-60s) and highs in the mid-80s. Light winds from the east. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Humidity begins creeping back up overnight. There's a chance of a passing shower or storm; otherwise, expect partly cloudy skies with lows near 70. Confidence: Medium-High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday through Sunday: The overall pattern changes little. Expect partly sunny, increasingly humid days with highs in the upper 80s and low 90s and about a 40 percent chance of late-day showers and thunderstorms each day. Nights remain partly to mostly cloudy and muggy, with lows from 70 to 75. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 3

Intense heat in 2006 sent temperatures to 101 degrees with record-warm nights, part of a prolonged stretch of 90-degree days that proved deadly across the region.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Less stormy than yesterday, but the humidity is just as oppressive — if not worse.| 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
